author: Ashgitt
quote: After this I've decided GTA really ain't for me. I never rate games 0 but honestly it's just totally boring. Job simulator, characters I do not gel with, performance isn't great either. I just genuinely struggle to slog through this game. Sorry, simply a boring game that for me I cannot understand the rave reviews, I guess messing stuff up and causing crime is attractive to casuals too. There are all many better games.

author: Ashgitt
quote: For me playing this game was so emotional, after playing then original when I was only 11 years old. They have created a masterpiece and done an amazing job, yes changed pieces but I'm excited in what's to come. This is the game of the generation for me. Thanks square x
